steps.en: Install the rg binary from a package manager or the release page
steps.zh: 从包管理器或 release 页装上 rg 二进制
steps.code: brew install ripgrep · choco install ripgrep

steps.en: From the project root, search for a pattern — optionally limited to a file type
steps.zh: 在项目根目录搜一个模式——可以只限某种文件类型

steps.en: Walks the tree on many threads, skipping gitignored, hidden and binary files
steps.zh: 多线程遍历目录树，跳过被 gitignore 的、隐藏的和二进制文件

steps.en: Pre-filters by literal fragments, then runs the full regex on the remaining lines
steps.zh: 先按字面片段预筛，再对剩下的行跑完整正则

steps.en: Prints matches grouped by file, with line numbers and colour
steps.zh: 按文件分组打印命中，带行号和颜色

value.en: Search a whole codebase interactively without wading through node_modules, build output or binaries
value.zh: 随想随搜整个代码库，不用在 node_modules、构建产物和二进制文件里蹚水

sources: https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep README (fetched 2026-10-08): 'Installation' brew install ripgrep / choco install ripgrep; 'Why should I use ripgrep?' rg -tpy foo, automatic filtering of .gitignore/.ignore/.rgignore, hidden and binary files, rg -uuu; 'Is it really faster' Rust regex engine (finite automata, SIMD, literal optimizations), lock-free parallel recursive directory iterator via the ignore crate
https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/blob/master/GUIDE.md (fetched 2026-10-08): any file with a NUL byte is binary; RIPGREP_CONFIG_PATH
